comments.author: ciju-juniper
comments.body:
@lguohan @shine4chen  The build failure reason is this:

**dpkg-deb: error: control directory has bad permissions 770 (must be >=0755 and <=0775)**

ciju@vlinux-5:~/sonic/commit/apr_14/sonic-buildimage/src/iccpd/debian$ ls -ld DEBIAN
drwxrwx--- 2 ciju ciju 4096 Apr  8 00:24 DEBIAN

If the permission is set to **'0755'** for DEBIAN directory, build will proceed.

ciju@vlinux-5:~/sonic/commit/apr_14/sonic-buildimage/src/iccpd/debian$ ls -ld DEBIAN
**drwxr-xr-x** 2 ciju ciju 4096 Apr  8 00:24 DEBIAN

Another workaround is to disable ICCPD docker in **rules/config**
    **ENABLE_ICCPD = n**

@shine4chen Could you fix this issue?

comments.author: jianjundong
comments.body:
@lguohan @shine4chen @BaluAlluru
I just downloaded a code from GitHub on April 8, the permissions of control directory is 0755.

jianjun@nps65:/home/jianjun/git_master/sonic-buildimage/src/iccpd/debian$ ls -ld
drwxr-xr-x 3 jianjun jianjun 4096 Apr  7 23:34 .
jianjun@nps65:/home/jianjun/git_master/sonic-buildimage/src/iccpd/debian$ cd DEBIAN/
jianjun@nps65:/home/jianjun/git_master/sonic-buildimage/src/iccpd/debian/DEBIAN$ ls -ld
drwxr-xr-x 2 jianjun jianjun 4096 Apr  7 23:34 .

Is it related to the local compilation environment? Please check.

comments.author: ciju-juniper
comments.body:
@jianjundong  It's not fixed. Just checked again in the mainline code.

commit 7405f8cfea9eae265eb1e92086f31c5a897b78b7

ciju@vlinux-5:/tmp/sonic-buildimage/src/iccpd/debian$ ls -ld DEBIAN/
drwxrwx--- 2 ciju ciju 4096 Apr  9 12:52 DEBIAN/

comments.author: jianjundong
comments.body:
@ciju-juniper

This directory does not have permission control on GitHub. It should be related to your local compilation environment.

comments.author: lguohan
ciju-juniper
comments.body:
@jianjundong What do you mean by compilation environment? No one sets up SONiC compilation environment as it's created automatically. As @lguohan said, you need to organize the files properly. Look at the examples of other debian projects sourced to SONiC.

Make sure that you build all the targets from scratch and all are successfully built.

comments.author: tylerlinp
comments.body: @ciju-juniper The directory is not tracked by GIT, it gets OS default access permission when created. Maybe your user account `umask` is not `0022` but `0007`. I think it is not a good thing to `chmod` it when compiling.

comments.author: jianjundong
comments.body: We will raise a PR to change ENABLE_ICCPD = n at first, and will change the debianize progress follow the example later.
